idle_class_description: gentle bob + breath; feet stay grounded
method_note: Loop visibly moves (bob/breath); it is NOT the old static standing reuse. Overworld_front cells were eye-checked and rejected as a second pose (near-identical to battle_front). Manticlaw only: C frame is a second distinct locked battle_front cell.
timing_status: reconciled 2026-10-25: final timing recorded, see timing_reconciliation

timing_reconciliation.baseline_note: Calm baseline 2400ms = midpoint of research calm full-breath cycle 2.0-3.0s (BATTLE-ANIMATION-RESEARCH.md s5.2); s5.3 forbids shipping one idle for 51 creatures — variation by body/temperament is required, not a deviation to hide.
timing_reconciliation.rationale: Adopts the 2400ms calm baseline exactly. Old 1800ms was below the research per-body ranges for this class (medium biped 2.0-2.5s, quadruped 2.2-2.8s, BATTLE-ANIMATION-RESEARCH.md s5.3) and had no body/temperament justification for running faster than calm.
timing_reconciliation.research_refs: s5.2 calm breath 2.0-3.0s (baseline 2400ms = midpoint); s5.3 medium biped 2.0-2.5s, quadruped 2.2-2.8s
timing_reconciliation.engine_note: Idle never stops during the opponent's turn; second creature's loop is offset 30-50% of a cycle in the engine (s5.2) — engine behaviour, not a manifest timing change.
